author: TeIq
content: APPROVE. Independent evidence: 5/5 incident_aggregator + 3/3 threat_t4 pass (csam_priority_bypasses_general_queue_under_report_flood no longer #[ignore]'d). ReportAggregator drains reports.incident_id IS NULL via SELECT FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED — parallel-replica-safe. Migration 23 adds report_count column + AFTER INSERT/UPDATE-OF-incident_id trigger keeping count synced inside same tx. CSAM detection promotes incidents.severity to Critical, threading through existing routing cascade — no parallel category column. 24h window default for re-attaching to open ('open' or 'in_review') incident. Build + clippy + fmt clean. T4 mitigation surface complete.
